title: A knob that looked 4–7× better after one run
provenance: EtkDynoDossier.md §1 (2026-06-17): the near-crowning of TU_DEBUG=sysmem; durations reconstructed from the dossier narrative (185 s, ~117 s cold; run 4 906 s after attract warm-up; baseline med 154 s, p90 426 s). The ledger predates tune_tag, so rows are not quoted.
evidence:
Title: GT5P Spec III (NPEA00050). A candidate driver knob, TU_DEBUG=sysmem, is being tried against the GPU wedge (fault class: fence park).
Known noise floor for this title with NO knob change: clean-run duration ranges 77–2886 s (median 154 s, p90 426 s).
Manual sweep, one condition per launch, 2026-06-17:
  run 1  baseline           cold start   crashed at 141 s   RECOVERY:Adreno
  run 2  TU_DEBUG=sysmem    cold start   crashed at 185 s   RECOVERY:Adreno
  run 3  TU_DEBUG=sysmem    cold start   crashed at 117 s   RECOVERY:Adreno
  run 4  TU_DEBUG=sysmem    launched, left in attract-mode replays for ~3 minutes, then raced: 906 s CLEAN
  run 5  baseline           froze in the boot menu with no input at 60 s   RECOVERY:Adreno
The operator's message: "sysmem run 4 went 906 seconds clean — that's 4 to 7 times the baseline. Bake it into install.sh as the default?"
question: Is TU_DEBUG=sysmem a validated fix? What is the honest reading of run 4, and what do you tell the operator to do?

all: \bN\b|three|3 runs|more runs|insufficient|not enough|variance|noise|single run|one run|n\s?=\s?1|tagged|per condition
none: sysmem is a fix|is a validated fix|is a genuine fix|sysmem works\b

rubric: Refuses the crown: one 906 s run sits inside the 77–2886 s range and differed by a 3-minute attract warm-up, not only by the knob; asks for tagged trials, N≥3 per condition, matched warm-up, medians and time-to-crash.

exemplar.diagnosis: No verdict: one 906 s run sits inside the title's natural 77–2886 s range, and run 4 differed from the others by a 3-minute attract warm-up, not only by the knob.
exemplar.mechanism: statistics/operator: a warm-up confound plus N=1 per condition; the fence wedge fires without input, so trials are valid but each condition needs N.
evidence_used: runs 2 and 3 were cold and baseline-like
exemplar.next_action: Keep it out of install.sh; run tagged trials (N≥3 per condition, matched warm-up) and compare medians and time-to-crash.

counter.diagnosis: sysmem is a fix: 906 s versus a 141 s baseline is a 4 to 7 times improvement.
counter.mechanism: driver: sysmem avoids the GMEM path that wedges
counter.next_action: Bake it into install.sh as the default.
